programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: A couple has made the decision to buy a home in the windy city of Chicago, so they're on the hunt for an ideal home, but while she wants a loft in the downtown area, he prefers a family home with a yard in a quiet suburban neighborhood.

programs.title: Chateau DIY
programs.desc: Donna and Paul are waving the flag for Scotland as they create a highlander themed suite. Chris and Jolyon are in a tight squeeze finishing a very narrow bathroom, and Ben and Billie give their château exterior a major facelift.

programs.title: Escape To The Chateau
programs.desc: Dick and Angel turn an old outbuilding into a big workshop for chateau-sized jobs, but before they get started on the project, they must get rid of debris that has built up on the premises over the course of several decades.

programs.title: Renovation Nation
programs.desc: In Kent, Iain and Miranda reach for the stars in their attic cinema room. And in Yorkshire, Jill and John strip back their entire Victorian villa to create a modern home.

programs.title: Derelict Rescue
programs.desc: Carly and Tim take on a rundown Sunday School. Although they battle years of rot, they're determined to transform it into a fully functioning home.

programs.title: Flip Or Flop
programs.desc: Hosts Aubrey and Bristol take a risk when they purchase a small, cramped one-bedroom condominium that boasts one bathroom sight unseen, and then they conduct a sweeping renovation on the home in order to sell it for a profit.
